mechanism: Both are first-generation antipsychotics/antihistamines with additive anticholinergic, sedative, and extrapyramidal effects; both inhibit dopamine and have overlapping metabolism via CYP2D6.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use with extreme caution; monitor for excessive sedation, anticholinergic toxicity, extrapyramidal symptoms, and orthostatic hypotension; consider alternative agents.
